facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and Innovation's published ICT Sector Strategic Plan 2024/25-2028/29 is presented as a plan the Ministry and its affiliated agencies are committed to implement, with no draft status stated; dated by its cover 1 January 2025 (document date used).
The plan is a PDF on the Ministry of ICT and Innovation's own site (minict.gov.rw).
The plan covers FY2024/25 to 2028/29 (document date used).

The contents list an Implementation Plan (section 4.1, Appendix II) and Cost and Financing with budget allocation across priority areas (section 5); only the contents are in the excerpt, so no figures are given (document date used).
The plan commits the Ministry of ICT and Innovation and its affiliated agencies to deliver its programmes and initiatives (document date used).
